label: Travel and Directions
heading: Egyptian Arabic Travel and Directions — 53 Words

examples.arabic: أحمد قال لصاحبه علي: الجو هنا جميل أوي النهاردة.
examples.english: Ahmed said to his friend Ali: The atmosphere here is very beautiful today.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed al le sahbo Ali: El gaw hena gamil awi ennaharda.

examples.arabic: العيلة كلهم كويسين واخواتي كانوا هنا امبارح
examples.english: The family are all well and my siblings were here yesterday.
examples.transliteration: El eila kollohom kwayessin we akhwaty kano hena embareh

examples.arabic: انا مستني صاحبي عشان هو بيشتغل قريب من هنا
examples.english: I am waiting for my friend because he works near here.
examples.transliteration: ana mestanni sahby ashan howa biyeshtaghal oreyeb men hena

examples.arabic: يوسف: نادي الزمالك، صاحبي عنده ماتش كورة هناك.
examples.english: Youssef: Zamalek club, my friend has a football match there.
examples.transliteration: Youssef: Nady el Zamalek, sahby 3ando match kora henak.

examples.arabic: إحنا بناكل الأكل لكن بنفكر في الناس هناك.
examples.english: We eat the food but we think about the people there.
examples.transliteration: Ehna binakul el-akl lakin binfakkir fi en-nas honak.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: بعد كده، رحنا بيت جدنا عشان العيلة كلها بتتجمع هناك.
examples.english: After that, we went to our grandfather's house because the whole family gathers there.
examples.transliteration: baad keda, rohna beyt gedena ashan el ayla kolaha betetgamaa henak.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: اه معلش الكورة طارت بعيد اوي
examples.english: Oh, never mind, the ball flew very far.
examples.transliteration: Ah ma'alesh el koora tarat ba'eed awi.

examples.arabic: الجدة عايزة مكان هادي جدا بعيد عن الناس
examples.english: Grandma wants a very quiet place far from people.
examples.transliteration: El gedda ayza makan hady geddan ba'eed 'an el nas.

examples.arabic: سالت راجل لو سمحت الماركت هنا ولا بعيد
examples.english: I asked a man: 'Excuse me, is the market here or far?'
examples.transliteration: Sa'alt ragel: 'Law samaht, el-market hena walla ba'eed?'

examples.arabic: السوق قريب اوي من بيتي
examples.english: The market is very close to my house.
examples.transliteration: el souk arib awi men beity

examples.arabic: هو وراني الطريق وقالي انه قريب من البيت
examples.english: He showed me the way and told me it's close to the house.
examples.transliteration: Huwa warrany el taree' we 'aly eno 'areeb men el bayt.

examples.arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله بيتي قريب من هنا تحب تشرب مايه
examples.english: "I'm good, thank God. My house is close by. Would you like to drink some water?"
examples.transliteration: Ana kowayyes el-hamdu lellah. Beyti 'arayyeb men hena. Tehebb teshrob mayya?

examples.arabic: كلنا قعدنا قدام التلفزيون في الصالون بتاعنا.
examples.english: All of us sat in front of the television in our living room.
examples.transliteration: Kollena 2a3adna 2oddam el televiseon fi el saloon beta3na.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: احمد قدام البيت والباب مقفول
examples.english: Ahmed is in front of the house and the door is closed.
examples.transliteration: ahmed oddam el beit wa el baab makfool

examples.arabic: هو كان بيشرب قهوة قدام الباب
examples.english: He was drinking coffee in front of the door.
examples.transliteration: howa kan beyishrab ahwa oddam elbab

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: الطريق كان زحمة جدا زي كل يوم
examples.english: The road was very crowded, like every day.
examples.transliteration: Et tareeq kan zahma geddan zayy koll yom

examples.arabic: عارفة ان الطريق هيبقى زحمة النهاردة عشان كده لازم انزل دلوقتي
examples.english: I know the road will be crowded today, that's why I must leave now.
examples.transliteration: Arfa ennet taree' hayeb'a zahma ennaharda ashan keda lazem anzil delwa'ti.

examples.arabic: كنت ماشي في القاهرة وزهقت من الطريق فتهت
examples.english: I was walking in Cairo and got tired of the road, so I got lost.
examples.transliteration: Kont mashi fi el Qahira we zehe't men el taree', fa tehet.

examples.arabic: الراجل ضحك وقال آه المحطة دي ورا ضهرك
examples.english: The man laughed and said: "Ah, the station is right behind your back!"
examples.transliteration: El ragel dehek w 'al: "Ah, el mahatta di wara dahrak!"

examples.arabic: الطريق كان زحمة جدا زي كل يوم
examples.english: The road was very crowded, like every day.
examples.transliteration: Et tareeq kan zahma geddan zayy koll yom

examples.arabic: عارفة ان الطريق هيبقى زحمة النهاردة عشان كده لازم انزل دلوقتي
examples.english: I know the road will be crowded today, that's why I must leave now.
examples.transliteration: Arfa ennet taree' hayeb'a zahma ennaharda ashan keda lazem anzil delwa'ti.

examples.arabic: كنت ماشي في القاهرة وزهقت من الطريق فتهت
examples.english: I was walking in Cairo and got tired of the road, so I got lost.
examples.transliteration: Kont mashi fi el Qahira we zehe't men el taree', fa tehet.

examples.arabic: الدنيا بتمطر جامد برا والجو ساقعة خالص في يوم شتا جميل
examples.english: It's raining heavily outside and the weather is very cold on a beautiful winter day.
examples.transliteration: El-donya betmaṭṭar gamid barra wel-gaw saq'a khales fi yom sheta gameel.

examples.arabic: الجو برا مطر دلوقتي
examples.english: The weather outside is rainy now.
examples.transliteration: El gaw barra matar dilwa'ti

examples.arabic: الدنيا بتمطر جامد برا البيت والجو شبه الشتا
examples.english: It's raining heavily outside the house and the weather is like winter.
examples.transliteration: El donia betmaTTar gamed barra el beit wel gaww shabah el sheta

examples.arabic: أنا وصلت نيويورك مع أخواتي الاتنين الأسبوع اللي فات عشان نزور ابن عمنا.
examples.english: I arrived in New York with my two brothers last week to visit our cousin.
examples.transliteration: Ana wasalt New York ma'a akhwati el etneen el osbou'a elly fat ashan nezoor ebn ammena.

examples.arabic: هو كان شخص كويس اوي وساعدني والحمد لله وصلت بالسلامة
examples.english: He was a very good person and helped me and thank God I arrived safely.
examples.transliteration: Howa kan shakhs kwayes awi we saadni wel hamdullelah wasalt bel salama

examples.arabic: وصلت هناك بسرعة
examples.english: I arrived there quickly.
examples.transliteration: weselt henak be soraa

examples.arabic: شويه وصاحبي وصل وقالي يلا بينا
examples.english: A little while later, my friend arrived and told me, "Let's go."
examples.transliteration: Shwaya we sahby wasal we qali yalla beina.
examples.storyTitle: Waiting for My Friend at the Café

examples.arabic: صاحبي وصل يا دوب بعد خمس دقايق
examples.english: My friend arrived after barely five minutes
examples.transliteration: Saḥbi waṣal ya doob ba'd khamas da'aye'

examples.arabic: جدو قال إيه في يومي كان ممكن ترجع كل حاجة
examples.english: Grandpa said, "What? In my day, you could return anything!"
examples.transliteration: Geddo 'al eh fe yomi kan mumken teragga' koll haga.

examples.arabic: مريم، بعد ما حسّت إن ده أملها الأخير، قررت ترجع البيت تدور على شغلانة تانية بسرعة عشان تجمع باقي الفلوس وترجعله بكرة الصبح.
examples.english: Maryam, after feeling that this was her last hope, decided to go back home to quickly look for another job to gather the rest of the money and return to him tomorrow morning.
examples.transliteration: Maryam, ba3d ma hasset en da amalha el-akheer, qarrarat terga3 el-beit tedawwar 3ala shoghlana tanya besor3a 3ashan tagamma3 ba'i el-felous we terga3lo bokra el-sobh.

examples.arabic: هي عايزة ترجع العصير اللي اشترته امبارح
examples.english: She wants to return the juice she bought yesterday
examples.transliteration: Heya ayza terga' el-a'seer elly eshtarito embarah

examples.arabic: عم حامد رد بابتسامة: "صباح النور يا علي! كويس الحمد لله، إيه اللي مصحيك بدري كده؟ أنت لازم تروح الدرس بتاعك؟" علي قال: "أيوه، أنا مجبور ألاقي كتاب للدرس دلوقتي، ومش لاقيه هنا. المكتبة قافلة."
examples.english: Uncle Hamed replied with a smile: "Good morning, Aly! I'm fine, thank God. What got you up so early like this? Do you have to go to your lesson?" Aly said: "Yes, I am forced to find a book for the lesson now, and I can't find it here. The bookstore is closed."
examples.transliteration: Am Hamed radd be-ebtisama: "Sabah el-noor ya Aly! Kwayyes el-hamdu lellah, eh elli masahhik badri keda? Enta lazim teruh el-dars betaak?" Aly qal: "Aywa, ana magboor ala'i ketab lel-dars delwa'ty, w mesh la'ieh hena. El-maktaba qafla."
examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: الراجل ابتسم و قال عايز تروح المحطة
examples.english: The man smiled and said "Do you want to go to the station?"
examples.transliteration: El ragel ibtasam w aal "Ayez tarouh el mahatta?"
examples.storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

examples.arabic: يوم جميل جوا البيت
examples.english: It's a beautiful day inside the house.
examples.transliteration: yom gameel gowwa el beit

examples.arabic: لما روحت بيتي بالليل كلمت اصحابي عشان انا بكون مبسوط لما بتكلم معاهم
examples.english: When I went home at night, I called my friends because I get happy when I talk with them.
examples.transliteration: Lamma rowwaht beiti bel leil kallamt ashabi ashan ana bakoon mabsoot lamma batkallem ma'ahom

examples.arabic: امبارح انا روحت ازور خالتي
examples.english: Yesterday I went to visit my aunt.
examples.transliteration: Imbareh ana roht azour khalti.

examples.arabic: النهاردة روحت أزور خالتي في بيتها
examples.english: Today I went to visit my aunt at her house.
examples.transliteration: El naharda rooht azor khalty fi beitaha.

examples.arabic: سارة راحت تزور طنط منى وطنت منى فتحت الباب وقالت أهلاً بيكي يا سارة
examples.english: Sara went to visit Aunt Mona and Aunt Mona opened the door and said "Welcome Sara."
examples.transliteration: Sara rahet tezour Tant Mona we Tant Mona fatahet el-bab we qalet ahlan beeki ya Sara

examples.arabic: نهلة راحت السوق عشان تشتري هدوم جديدة
examples.english: Nahla went to the market to buy new clothes.
examples.transliteration: Nahla rahet el souq ashan teshtari hedoom gedeeda.

examples.arabic: ماما راحت مع بنتها المحل
examples.english: Mama went with her daughter to the shop.
examples.transliteration: Mama rahet ma'a bentaha el mahall

examples.arabic: السطل نزل جوه البير.
examples.english: The bucket went down inside the well.
examples.transliteration: El satl nezl gowa el bir.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: هو حط عشر شنط عيش جوه العربية بحرص.
examples.english: He put ten bags of bread inside the cart carefully.
examples.transliteration: Howa hat ashar shonat eish gowa el-arabiya be-hers.

examples.arabic: انا في البيت جوه
examples.english: I am at home, inside.
examples.transliteration: Ana fel beit gowwa.

examples.arabic: النهاردة الصبح وانا نازل شفت جارتي ام احمد على السلم سلمت عليها
examples.english: This morning as I was going down, I saw my neighbor Umm Ahmed on the stairs and greeted her.
examples.transliteration: Ennaharda eṣ-ṣobḥ wana nāzel shoft gārti Omm Aḥmed ʿala s-sollem sallamt ʿalēha

examples.arabic: هو نصحني امشي مع القطه بتاعته
examples.english: He advised me to walk with his cat.
examples.transliteration: howa nasahni amshi maa el otta betato

examples.arabic: قال امشي على طول وبعدين يمين
examples.english: He said walk straight ahead and then right.
examples.transliteration: aal emshi ala tool wa baadeen yemeen

examples.arabic: يلا بينا امشي للشغل مع السلامة
examples.english: Let's go walk to work goodbye
examples.transliteration: Yalla bina amshy lel shoghl ma'a el salama

examples.arabic: كنت ماشية في الشارع وكنت تايهة جداً
examples.english: I was walking in the street and I was very lost.
examples.transliteration: Kont mashya fel share' w kont tayha geddan.

examples.arabic: منى كانت ماشية في شارع المعز، وفجأة شافت كتاب قديم خالص على فرشة صغيرة.
examples.english: Mona was walking in El Moez Street, and suddenly she saw a very old book on a small stand.
examples.transliteration: Mona kanet mashya fi share' el Mo'ez, we fag'a shafet ketab adim khales 'ala farsha soghayara.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: طلبت قهوه و قاعده ببص على الناس اللي ماشيه في الشارع
examples.english: I ordered coffee and am sitting watching the people walking in the street.
examples.transliteration: talabt ahwa w qa'ada babos ala el nas elly mashya fi el share'a

examples.arabic: عمر زعلان جدا وبيقول: "معلش يا عم، أنا هروح".
examples.english: Omar is very sad and says: "Sorry uncle, I will go".
examples.transliteration: Omar zaalaan gidan wa biyekool: "maalesh ya am, ana harooh".

examples.arabic: النهاردة هروح السوق مع ماما
examples.english: Today I will go to the market with mom.
examples.transliteration: Ennaharda harouh es-souq ma'a mama.

examples.arabic: هروح انا وصاحبتي مع بعض
examples.english: My friend and I will go together.
examples.transliteration: Harooh ana we sahbeti ma' ba'd

examples.arabic: في الاخر اتفقوا على كل حاجة وكانوا فرحانين ان اليوم قرب
examples.english: In the end, they agreed on everything and were happy that the day was near.
examples.transliteration: Fil akher ettafa'u 'ala kol ḥaga w kanu farḥaneen en el yom qarrab

examples.arabic: فرح اختي قرب وكلنا مبسوطين
examples.english: My sister's wedding is near, and we are all happy.
examples.transliteration: Farah okhty arrab we kollena mabsooteen.

examples.arabic: انا بحب السفر يالا نشوف مكان كويس
examples.english: I love to travel, let's go see a good place.
examples.transliteration: Ana bahebb es safar yalla neshoof makan kwayyes.

examples.arabic: هو كلم اصحابه بس هم رجعوا الفندق بدري
examples.english: He called his friends but they returned to the hotel early.
examples.transliteration: howa kalem ashabo bas homa regeo el fondoq badry.

examples.arabic: طيب هنشوف فندق كويس او بيت
examples.english: Okay, we will look for a good hotel or a house.
examples.transliteration: Tayyeb hanshoof fonde' kwayyes aw byt.

examples.arabic: ركبوا العربية بتاعتهم وراحوا السوق الكبير في القاهرة.
examples.english: They got into their car and went to the big market in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Rakbou el 3arabeya beta3ethom we rahou el soo2 el kebir fi el Qahera.

examples.arabic: انا وبابا في العربية ومش عارفين الشارع
examples.english: My dad and I are in the car and we do not know the street.
examples.transliteration: ana wa baba fi el aarabeya wa mesh aarefeen el shareaa

examples.arabic: انا بروح الشغل بالعربية
examples.english: I go to work by car.
examples.transliteration: ana barouh el shoghl bel arabeya

examples.arabic: مشيت كتير وحسيت اني تهت
examples.english: I walked a lot and felt that I got lost.
examples.transliteration: Meshit keteer we haseet enny tehet.

examples.arabic: بس مشيت كتير ومفيش قهوة في الشارع ده اللي انا فيه
examples.english: But I walked a lot and there's no coffee on this street I'm on.
examples.transliteration: Bass mesheet keteer wamafish ahwa fi esh-share' da elli ana feeh.

examples.arabic: بس انا مشيت لوحدي و فجأة لقيت نفسي تاهت
examples.english: But I walked alone and suddenly found myself lost.
examples.transliteration: Bas ana mesheet lewahdy w faga'a la'eet nafsi tahet.
